correlates.name: Isoniazid hepatotoxicity
correlates.presentation: 52-year-old man who drinks 6 beers a day; positive IGRA before adalimumab, so he began one daily oral drug plus pyridoxine 7 weeks ago for a planned 9 months. 1 week of nausea, anorexia, dark urine and right upper quadrant ache; T 37.4 C, scleral icterus, tender liver edge
correlates.workup: ALT 840 U/L, AST 710 U/L, alkaline phosphatase 160 U/L, total bilirubin 4.6 mg/dL, INR 1.3; hepatitis A, B and C serologies negative; liver tests were normal at baseline
correlates.management: Stop the drug at once; trend liver tests and INR; no alcohol; refer for transplant evaluation if liver failure develops. Prevention: baseline and periodic liver tests, extra caution with alcohol or when given with rifampin and pyrazinamide

correlates.name: Isoniazid peripheral neuropathy
correlates.presentation: 50-year-old woman 6 weeks into four-drug therapy for cavitary pulmonary TB; no vitamin supplement was prescribed. 2 weeks of burning and numbness in both feet, worse at night. Vitals normal, lungs clear, decreased pinprick sensation over the toes; vision and color testing normal
correlates.management: Add pyridoxine (vitamin B6) 10-50 mg/day and continue TB therapy; B6 belongs on every prescription of the katG-activated drug, which blocks B6 activation and so lowers glutamate-to-GABA conversion

correlates.name: Serotonin syndrome from linezolid and an SSRI
correlates.presentation: 34-year-old woman on sertraline for depression began an oral antibiotic 2 days ago for vancomycin-resistant enterococcal bacteremia. Now agitated, sweating, with diarrhea; T 39.6 C, HR 128, BP 150/90; tremor, myoclonic jerks, brisk reflexes and sustained ankle clonus
correlates.management: Treat as an emergency: stop both serotonergic drugs, cool and give benzodiazepines for agitation as needed, and start cyproheptadine (a 5-HT2A antagonist)

correlates.name: Thalidomide embryopathy
correlates.presentation: Newborn of a 24-year-old woman from Brazil treated for leprosy; she took an oral TNF-lowering, anti-angiogenic drug for painful red skin nodules in the first trimester, before she knew she was pregnant. Hands arise near the shoulders; long bones of all four limbs short or absent
correlates.management: Prevention: negative pregnancy tests before and during therapy and two forms of birth control for any patient who could conceive; never use the drug for first-trimester morning sickness
